title: D-094 visual-proof baseline: the 'before' set of the report and the website frozen at the wave-24 contract head (product-identical to main b4704161), with metrics and a re-runnable procedure
objective: Freeze the 'before' set for the D-094 redesign before any wave-24 product change is integrated: (1) the report PDF printed from the preview at main b4704161 (product-identical to the contract head), its nine pages rendered at 110 dpi in colour and in grey; (2) the website's Results view at 320, 390, 768, 1,024, 1,440 and 1,920 px (a viewport shot, a full-length shot and one shot per card) and the report preview; (3) the metrics: PDF words per page and in total (pdftotext, no -layout), pdfinfo -url link lines and their pages, internal issue/item link count, repeated sentences of 8+ words (distinct and printings), and the report HTML's visible words per section. The images stay outside git in the session folder; the manifest project-control/reports/D-094-visual-proof-before.md records the sha256 of every image and file, the metrics and the exact commands (scripts capture_before.mjs and metrics_before.py, kept beside the images), so the run can be repeated.
business_reason: D-094 R083 requires before-and-after screenshots of every changed page and view; R072/R077 measure the text budget and repeats against the before set. Without a frozen, re-runnable before set no later page change can be proven.

acceptance_scenarios.given: the report printed from the preview at main b4704161
acceptance_scenarios.then: all nine pages exist at 110 dpi in colour and in grey, each with its sha256 in the manifest
the Results view at 320, 390, 768, 1,024, 1,440 and 1,920 px (viewport, full length, each card) and the report preview exist, with sha256s

acceptance_scenarios.given: the printed PDF and the report HTML
acceptance_scenarios.then: the manifest records words per page and total (expected 364/193/291/338/245/719/296/346/201 = 2,993), the pdfinfo -url line count and pages (25 lines, 24 links on page 8), the internal issue/item link count (0), repeats (distinct and printings) and the HTML visible words per section

acceptance_scenarios.when: the metrics script runs a second time

acceptance_scenarios.given: the owner's preview running before the capture
acceptance_scenarios.then: the preview is running at main again and its status is recorded

risks: The website captures need the running preview; builders never touch ports 3000/3001/8000, so the orchestrator captures.
The plan's repeat figure 7 counts printings; the script records distinct sentences (3) and printings (7) so H2 compares like with like.
path_notes: Orchestrator-produced evidence task (M0-T189/M0-T191 precedent, task type governance per the round-3 critic P3). Images outside git (public repository; size).
